{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch7ipgumuA1RcR3okYFvW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I couldn't watch the video: `/app/.harbor_assets/` is empty and there's no `recording.mp4` anywhere in the container. So I worked out the defects by comparing the line-drawing code (`CPlayers::RenderHookCollLine` in `src/game/client/components/players.cpp`) with the hook physics (`CCharacterCore::Tick` in `src/game/gamecore.cpp`) and the settings page. That means I can't confirm these are the exact moments in the video. The client builds cleanly (`ninja` in `build/`), but I haven't run it in-game or on a test map.\n\n**What I found and fixed:**\n\n1. **Wrong colour from a tee behind a wall** (`players.cpp`). The check for tees went past the tile the hook would hit. A tee behind a wall turned the line yellow (\"A Tee\") even though the hook stops at the wall. It now stops at the hit point, the way the hook does.\n2. **Tees missed** (`gameclient.cpp`, `IntersectCharacter`). The client counted a hit at half the distance the game uses (`PhysicalSize()/2 + 2` instead of `PhysicalSize() + 2`). A hook that would grab a tee could show red or green, and the line ran past the tee.\n3. **Phantom tees** (`IntersectCharacter`). Connected players with no character (dead or spectating) still counted as targets at old or zero positions. They're now skipped.\n4. **Wrong thickness on diagonal aims**. The width direction was `direction(pi/2 - angle)`, which is only at a right angle to the line when aiming straight along an axis. The line got thinner off-axis and disappeared at 45°. It now uses the true perpendicular, so the width matches the preview at every angle.\n5. **Missing or wrongly ending line on levels with changed hook settings**. Hook speed and length were rounded down to whole numbers. A hook speed below 1 became 0 and the line wasn't drawn at all; fractional values made it end in the wrong place. They're now kept as decimals.\n6. **Player hooking turned off**. The line still showed tee hits when the level's `player_hooking` setting disables them. It now follows that setting.\n7. **Wrong end after a hook teleporter**. After a teleporter, the line restarted at the exit and measured hook length from there. The hook actually resumes 1.5 tee-widths further along the aim, measures length from that point, and uses the original aim rather than the rounded direction. The line now does the same.\n\nThe settings page and preview needed no changes.\n\n**Decision for you:** if you can put the recording back in `/app/.harbor_assets/`, I can check each fix against the frames it should cover."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2299,"cache_read_input_tokens":54148,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2299,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":5,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"174ef766-58c7-469f-b532-597cbae2460b","uuid":"80b4f051-f3a1-4405-8b9e-7a14bc8ae709","timestamp":"2026-11-17T02:36:31.732Z"}
